entities.name: PMID:27502060
observations: Murine α-myosin-peptide autoimmune myocarditis study: CEUS microbubbles targeting CD4, P-selectin, or leukocytes produced increased signals in moderate and severe myocarditis versus isotype control; CD4-targeted signal correlated with myocardial CD4+ T-cell infiltration.
Targeted CEUS detected endothelial inflammation and leukocyte infiltration even when standard functional imaging showed little change.

entities.name: CEUS detects EAM inflammation
observations: In a murine experimental autoimmune myocarditis model, targeted molecular CEUS signals were higher in moderate/severe disease versus isotype control; CD4-targeted signal correlated with myocardial CD4+ T-cell infiltration (PMID:27502060).

entities.name: PMID:31658281
observations: In murine EAM, leukocyte-, CD4-, and P-selectin-targeted CEUS at day 21 showed weak correlations with day-63 fibrosis (Spearman r=0.28, 0.44, 0.73; reported p=0.047, 0.01, 0.02 respectively), and did not correlate with later hemodynamic or functional measures.

entities.name: Experimental autoimmune myocarditis
observations: Animal model of myocarditis induced with α-myosin peptide in the direct molecular CEUS study; findings are preclinical and do not establish diagnostic performance in human patients.
